summary: The diff implements %TypedArray%.prototype.lastIndexOf in its file, following the spec steps in order. ValidateTypedArray (step 2) and TypedArrayLength (step 3) are called and propagated with `?`. Step 4 returns -1 when length is 0 before fromIndex is converted. Step 5 uses args.len() < 2 for "not present" and applies ToAbsoluteIndex with `?`, then min with length - 1. Step 6 loops while k >= 0, doing ToString (key_from_index), HasProperty, TypedArrayGetElement and IsStrictlyEqual, and step 7 returns -1. There are no test-shaped branches and no swallowed errors. The 6 remaining BigInt failures are honest not-implemented throws. The local to_absolute_index helper is the only questionable part, since the comment says it is "not yet in ops" and I could not verify that.
notes_for_next_attempt: Before merging, confirm that kahvi_core::ops does not already export a to_absolute_index helper. If it does, use it instead of the local copy. The non-generic note from the stub ("This method is not generic...") was dropped; restore it as a comment if the ticket wants the stub text kept. The 6 BigInt not-implemented results are acceptable as honest throws. Nothing else needs changing.
